劇本與課題：從忘記到記起: Script and lessons: from forgetting to remembering
上面是我們相信的部分：每個人本來完整，活著活著忘了一些，再慢慢記起；快或慢都會到: At the top is what we believe: everyone is whole to begin with, forgets a little along the way, and slowly remembers again; fast or slow, we get there, and slow does not mean behind. The script is the circumstances and lessons we meet along the way. In the middle: lessons come, but how you play them is yours. Below is what can be observed and practiced: what we cannot choose is the circumstance, what we can choose is how we respond; notice, choose a response, note it down, look back and adjust, round and round. Last is graduation: no longer needing this idea is fine too. The script is only for looking at your own path, not for explaining anyone else's pain.

02 劇本給課題，演法是自己的: 02　The script gives the lessons; the playing is yours
演法是自己的。: how you play them is yours.
我們用「劇本」這個詞，說一個信念：一個人一路上，會遇見某些處境和課題。課題，就是: We use the word “script” to name a belief: along the way, a person meets certain circumstances and lessons. A lesson is something that keeps coming back and asks you to learn to face it.
這不是說一切都安排好了、努力也沒用；也不是說一切都由你決定、夠努力就能改變。我們: This does not mean everything is already arranged and effort is pointless; nor that everything is up to you and enough effort changes it all. We believe in a third way: the lessons will come, but how you respond decides what the experience finally becomes.
「劇本決定你會遇見哪些課題／但你怎麼演／決定這個故事最後的質地。」: “The script decides which lessons you will meet / but how you play it / decides the texture of the story in the end.”
「劇本」只用來看自己走過的路。別人的痛和失去，我們不拿它來解釋。: The “script” is only for looking at the road you have walked yourself. We do not use it to explain other people's pain or loss.
03 怎麼回應，可以練習: 03　How we respond can be practiced
可以練，也可以記下來。: can be practiced, and can be written down.
劇本是信念，信不信都可以。但「怎麼回應」看得到：同一類處境又出現時，你說了什麼、: The script is a belief; you may believe it or not. But “how you respond” can be seen: when the same kind of situation comes again, what you said, what you did, what your body felt can all be written down and looked at again after a while.
練習不必等到撐不住才開始，也不用一次就做對。練得慢，也沒關係。哪天你不再需要「劇: You do not have to wait until you can't cope to begin, and you do not have to get it right the first time. Practicing slowly is fine. The day you no longer need the word “script”, or us, that is graduation.

信念，和可以檢查的事: Belief, and what can be checked
我們相信，每個人本來就完整，人生是一段從忘記到記起的路。: We believe everyone is whole to begin with, and that life is a road from forgetting to remembering.
我們相信，有些處境和課題，是一個人一路上會遇見的；我們叫它「劇本」。: We believe some circumstances and lessons are ones a person will meet along the way; we call this the “script”.
這些不需要、也無法用科學證明。你可以不同意。: None of this needs to be, or can be, proved by science. You are free to disagree.
同一類處境出現時，你怎麼回應：可以記錄，可以回頭比對。: How you respond when the same kind of situation comes up: you can record it and compare it later.
換一種回應之後，接下來的對話和結果有沒有不同：可以自己觀察。: Whether the conversation and result that follow are different after you respond another way: you can observe this yourself.
這些練習對沒聽過我們的人有沒有用、不靠任何一個人帶能不能走完：我們還在檢查，現在: Whether these practices work for people who have never heard of us, and whether they can be completed without anyone leading: we are still checking, and draw no conclusion for now.
我們不拿可以檢查的事，去證明我們相信的事。: We do not use what can be checked to prove what we believe.

換個角度看同一件事，心理學稱為「認知重評」。習慣這樣調整情緒的人，平均來說正向情: Looking at the same event from another angle is called cognitive reappraisal.
